Robertson (1968) isotemperature numerical table

Copyright 2013 Colour Developers
License: BSD-3-Clause; the full upstream license is retained in LICENSE.

Scope
Only the 31 rows of DATA_ISOTEMPERATURE_LINES_ROBERTSON1968 are transcribed
into the application's own bounded correlated-colour-temperature implementation.
The table's numerical values are unchanged, including u = 0.24792 at 325 mired.
Python functions, imports, NumPy, the Colour runtime and Adobe DNG SDK source,
functions or binaries are not included by this incorporation. This notice is
separate from the existing LibRaw CDDL selection and its retained notices.

Upstream scientific references and attribution
The table-specific documentation cites Wyszecki, Gunther, and Stiles, W. S.
(2000), Color Science: Concepts and Methods, Quantitative Data and Formulae,
Table 1(3.11), Isotemperature Lines, p. 228, Wiley, ISBN 978-0-471-39918-6.
The upstream table and note credit Bruce Lindbloom for the 325 mired correction
from 0.24702 to 0.24792. These references are retained as provenance, not as
additional software dependencies or endorsements.
The source module also cites Adobe DNG SDK 1.3.0.0 for its Python conversion
functions. Those functions are outside this numerical-table incorporation;
no claim is made that Colour's BSD license relicenses Adobe SDK code.
